import re

def parse(lines):
    kv = re.compile(r'^\s+(?P<key>[^:]*?)[ .]*: (?P<value>.*)$')
    dash = re.compile(r'^\s*-{5,}\s*$')
    cols = ['Entry', 'Record Name', 'Record Type', 'Time To Live', 'Data Length', 'Section', 'Record Kind', 'Record Data', 'Status']
    rows = []
    used = []
    skip = []
    entry = ''
    cur = None
    n = len(lines)
    for i in range(n):
        line = lines[i]
        s = line.strip()
        if not s:
            continue
        if dash.match(line):
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        if i + 1 < n and dash.match(lines[i + 1]):
            entry = s
            cur = None
            used.append(i)
            continue
        if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z]:\\.*>', line) or s == 'Windows IP Configuration':
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        m = kv.match(line)
        if m:
            key = m.group('key').strip()
            val = m.group('value').strip()
            if key == 'Record Name' or cur is None:
                cur = dict((c, '') for c in cols)
                cur['Entry'] = entry
                rows.append(cur)
            if key.endswith('Record') and key != 'Record':
                cur['Record Kind'] = key[:-len('Record')].strip()
                cur['Record Data'] = val
            elif key in cur:
                cur[key] = val
            else:
                cur['Record Kind'] = key
                cur['Record Data'] = val
            used.append(i)
            continue
        if entry:
            r = dict((c, '') for c in cols)
            r['Entry'] = entry
            r['Status'] = s
            rows.append(r)
            cur = None
            used.append(i)
        else:
            skip.append(i)
    return {'blocks': [{'name': 'dns_cache', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': used, 'records': rows}], 'skip': skip}
